content.text: Found it — Bánh Mì Bà Lan, the crew-favourite bánh mì spot, 260 m from Avatar Danang Hotel — but the trip has no plan yet, so there's nothing to add it to just yet. The plan starts once setup is finished and I draft the whole trip, and then I'll happily slot it in for you.
